applicant.name: Dr. Pieter de Vries
applicant.organisation: University Medical Center Utrecht, Julius Center

request.purpose: Production of official health statistics for the national health report.
request.question: What is the mean systolic blood pressure of adults with hypertension, by sex and age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Use the latest systolic blood pressure (LOINC 8480-6) per patient; patients without a value are left out.
Report per sex and age band: adults with hypertension who have a systolic value and their mean systolic blood pressure, one decimal.
